## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register new files. The refresh helper overwrites existing integrity baselines, allowing edits to tracked files to escape verification; this should be fixed before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — If `tracked.txt` was hand-edited, calling `refresh_fingerprints` with `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` replaces its original fingerprint with the edited file’s fingerprint. — Subsequent verification succeeds and loses the ability to detect the unauthorized edit.
